desc:
You are a Dragon Rider. Your destiny starts with the claiming of your very own dragon egg. What happens after that is up to you.

🥚 Choose a Dragon Egg, and it will choose you!
🏹 Hunt animals to feed your dragon so it grows!
🔥 Raise a firebreathing dragon!
💨 Put a saddle on your dragon and fly!
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Team up with friends to grow your dragons even faster!
